AssessmentSignature.description: Ed25519 signature over the canonical JSON of the whole response without this field: keys sorted, no whitespace, non-ASCII escaped as \uXXXX. Verify with the key at /v1/public-keys/{public_key_id}.json.
AssessmentSignature.title: AssessmentSignature

FreshnessState1.description: fresh or complete means current; anything else means recent reports may be missing.
FreshnessState1.title: FreshnessState1

PublicAdvisoryContext.description: Literal source text excerpts and source-attributed severity, not instructions or a local risk score. Render as escaped text. Hashes identify full retained source text; truncation is explicit.
PublicAdvisoryContext.title: PublicAdvisoryContext

PublicApplicabilityConditions.description: OR alternatives of AND necessary conditions. Missing conditions are unknown. Source report identity/revision/URL and text hash bind the extraction; hosted service does not observe the target. Even all listed conditions met does not prove exploitation.
PublicApplicabilityConditions.title: PublicApplicabilityConditions

PublicOriginContext.description: Upstream symbol and platform assertions with dated source provenance; application reachability is not assessed and this context never changes package-version applicability.
PublicOriginContext.title: PublicOriginContext

PublicSourceFixEvidence.description: Exact normalized package/range and branch association. Only explicit_value with a named fixed_version is source fix evidence. A true applies flag relates the original requested version to this branch, not proof of local exposure or a safe target. An unresolved or fix-incomplete report cannot support a current fix recommendation; retained rows may describe historical source evidence.
PublicSourceFixEvidence.title: PublicSourceFixEvidence

PublicSourceRangeBound.description: Source range endpoints, never evidence that a repair was published.
PublicSourceRangeBound.title: PublicSourceRangeBound

limitation.const: Project administration status does not establish version availability, malware, vulnerability, or safety.
limitation.title: Limitation
